query_normalized.basis: TPC-B-like built-in script: three UPDATE, one SELECT, one INSERT; BEGIN and END excluded from query unit. No vacuum during load; max-tries=1, zero failed transactions.

protocol.backend: Elestio S3 through verified HTTPS accounting proxy
protocol.postgres: One fresh scale2 DB, 256 transactions, 1280 business SQL statements; CPU1, memory512MiB, all fsync/checksum settings enabled.
protocol.restarts: Warm same local directory; cold fresh directory + adoption. Database integrity checked after both. Both use cache enabled128MiB.
protocol.metadata: ABBA off/on/on/off on identical HEAD and same local files, two repeats each; only index cache budget differs 0/128MiB. No application I/O between these four opens.
protocol.cost_scope: All HTTP attempts including retries. Query costs cover load + orderly drain; setup/restarts separate. Pricing projected on Tigris, not provider invoice.
protocol.timings: Instrumented diagnostic durations; proxy and shared VM caches affect them, not a direct performance benchmark.
